title: Exact CKM fibre alignment
statement: The tripling fibre of the holding point and the tripling fibre of the One force a complete asymmetric three-by-three overlap object with uniform diagonal, unequal adjacent bands and one unique far corner.
generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis product for exact ckm fibre alignment from carrier, dependency, relation, enumeration, minimality, measurement direction, record and extension.
grammar_boundary: Every exact finite carrier named by the law and the complete product of its eight registered binary form axes.

induction_step: Each mass/channel successor appends exactly one generated overlap cell until all nine exist.
exclusions: no V1/V2 executable, result table, certificate or measurement as a derivation premise
no target-selected coefficient, bracket, iteration count, correction or candidate neighbourhood
no semantic numerical zero, negative magnitude, irrational, imaginary or floating proof value
no solved irrational algebraic root; exact polynomials and rational enclosures only
no external value accessible before the formal seal
